requirements.label: Media Studies language alternatives
requirements.details: Obtain at least 50% in English or in an African language. Either language route can satisfy this subject condition.

requirements.details: Alongside English, achieve at least 50% in either History or Economics.

requirements.label: African language for Language Practice
requirements.details: The course page and prospectus set a 50% minimum in an African language. The Department of African Languages separately specifies an African home language at NSC level 5 and a pass in English as a home or first additional language. Confirm which subject standard applies for the intake.

requirements.label: Entry to the Higher Certificate in Music
requirements.details: Present a National Senior Certificate with adequate achievement in English. The 2027 course entry does not publish a separate APS cutoff.

requirements.label: Science teaching subjects
requirements.details: For this teaching stream, earn at least 50% in two subjects selected from Mathematics, Physical Sciences and Life Sciences. English has its own 50% requirement.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Commerce teaching subjects
requirements.details: For this teaching stream, earn at least 50% in two subjects selected from Accounting, Business Studies and Economics. English has its own 50% requirement.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Humanities, Languages and Social Sciences teaching subjects
requirements.details: For this teaching stream, earn at least 50% in two subjects selected from History, Geography, Sepedi, Tshivenda and Xitsonga. English has its own 50% requirement.

source.title: University of Venda · 2027 undergraduate prospectus

requirements.label: Foundation Phase mathematics and languages
requirements.details: The 2027 subject list gives 50% for Mathematical Literacy, 40% for Mathematics and 50% for languages, naming Tshivenda, Sepedi and Xitsonga. It does not say which combinations of mathematics and language subjects satisfy the rule. Confirm the applicable combination with the School of Education.
